targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-980 adjudicated the H-c / H-readout-regime sibling leg of sd_e1_residual_crush_locus and ELIMINATED it: its declared null (both readouts agree -- damping under each) held with a real margin. Because the hybrid and E1-alone readouts are bit-identical at h=1 on all 16 cells, growth_e1alone(h) = growth_hybrid(h) x r(h) is an identity rather than an approximation; a flip to 'not damped' required r_ON/r_OFF between 1.828 and 7.975, and the measured ratio was 0.4922-0.9200 on every one of the 16 decision cells. Equivalently, under the E1-alone readout the OFF arm's depth growth exceeds the ON arms' by 2.52x-10.99x on every cell (against 1.83x-7.98x under hybrid): the E1-alone readout moves every cell FURTHER onto the damped side, never toward the discriminating one. Verdict 8/8 damped under both readouts on both ON arms, on a healthy substrate (2,614-2,705 grad steps per cell, gap 0 every seed; grad_cos_samples 262-271, never 0; cr_real_h1 0.1998-0.2677 against a 1e-4 floor; zero missing action calls; trained_loss_last_over_first_fifth 0.405-0.729). The sign is also opposite to the hypothesis on the consumer's own statistic: at h=30 the hybrid readout reports 1.16x-2.36x HIGHER absolute cr_ratio than E1-alone on every ON cell (and ~1.0x on OFF), so the hybrid consumer is if anything over-generous to the ON arms at depth rather than suppressing them. The evaluator's hybrid E1/E2 regime is therefore NOT what suppresses E1-side divergence at depth. FOUR BOUNDS, all disclosed. (1) The run's PASS token carries no scientific information: status/outcome/verdict are assigned unconditionally once readiness passes (driver:1577) and every criterion is emitted passed:true (driver:1587); the finding lives entirely in interpretation.label. (2) The hybrid half of this run is bit-identical to V3-EXQ-976 across all 16 cells and all 7 horizons (96/112 cell fields exactly equal; the 16 differences are all arm_fingerprint). That cuts two ways: 'replicates' in the self-route label describes a byte-level re-emission rather than an independent replication sample, but it is also what makes the pre-registered null's 'on the same trained cells' clause literally true. Only the E1-alone series is new evidence. (3) A 109x readout discrepancy in the discriminating direction exists on ARM_single_step_stateful seed2024 (hybrid growth 0.347 vs E1-alone 37.9 at h=30). That arm's exclusion from the verdict is PRE-REGISTERED in the driver's ON_ARMS/OFF_ARM/DEPTH0_ARMS definitions (driver:279-321), not post hoc -- what the V3-EXQ-976 autopsy separately called post hoc at n=4 was treating that cell as an outlier in anchor-vs-ON comparisons. The discrepancy is a degenerate-base artifact: the cell's h=1 cr_ratio is 2.98e-05, ~100x below every other cell, while its E1-alone h=30 value sits inside the ordinary band. With that arm substituted as OFF, both readouts still agree (neither_damped). (4) SCOPE: the null was measured on trajectory-accuracy arms only, since no divergence-preserving arm exists yet, so the conclusion that the hybrid consumer would not under-read such an objective is extrapolated by sign rather than measured. The cheap confirmer costs nothing: keep 980's E1-alone readout beside the hybrid at h=30 in the ITEM-3 driver.
learning_extracted: The readout regime is eliminated as an explanation for the E1 residual crush. The remaining live legs are all about the objective (class, dose) or the output parameterisation -- the discrimination has genuinely narrowed by one axis (eval-dynamics closed).

A diagnostic whose status is assigned unconditionally on readiness should not also emit status: PASS -- the token is read as a scientific verdict by every downstream consumer including pending_review.md. Emit the readiness state and carry the outcome only in interpretation.label.
When a probe's control half is a byte-identical re-run of a prior experiment, say so in the label: 'replicates' implies an independent sample and this was a re-emission.

A completeness guard denominated on the invocation's own seed list (expected_total = len(seeds) x len(horizons), driver:1497) cannot detect an under-run of seeds; registered_majority_seeds is computed and written to the manifest but never read by any verdict. Latent here (the run used its full 4 seeds), corrupting in a short-seed invocation.

An anchor arm excluded from the verdict by pre-registered design can still be the only place a discriminating signal appears. Reporting it (as this run's manifest does) is what let the exclusion be audited as principled rather than convenient.
